startUrls.title: Websites to scan
startUrls.description: Paste one website per line (or add multiple URLs). The Actor will return one summary row per website.

maxSites.title: Max websites per run
maxSites.description: Safety limit to keep runs fast and cheap (recommended 25–100). Extra URLs will be ignored.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Max extra pages per site
maxPagesPerSite.description: How many additional internal pages (contact/about/support/help) to scan besides the homepage. Keep low for speed.

extractSocialLinks.title: Extract social links
extractSocialLinks.description: Extract social profile links found on the homepage/contact pages (passive; does not crawl social sites).

pushEmptyRecord.title: Push EMPTY record when nothing found
pushEmptyRecord.description: If true, pushes a placeholder row when no contacts are found (useful for tracking coverage).

outputCsv.title: Export CSV (OUTPUT.csv)
outputCsv.description: Save OUTPUT.csv to Key-Value Store (and ./output locally).

outputXlsx.title: Export XLSX (OUTPUT.xlsx)
outputXlsx.description: Save OUTPUT.xlsx to Key-Value Store (and ./output locally).
